text:
pranav: quick handoff on the cross-family GPTQ runs i pushed to prod-sim — short summary below. ran ~2k eval samples (summarization, code, reasoning). models: llama-2-13b / mistral-7b-instruct / qwen-14b. gptq config: 4-bit, per-channel, group=64 default. awq baseline also included.
sara: awesome — any big surprises?
pranav: llama-2-13b: quality delta ~-0.2% EM overall, latency +8% vs fp16, memory down ~40% (good cost win).
mistral-7b: noticed a regression on long-context summarization — EM down ~3.4% at seq>4k, instruction-following degrades on multi-turn prompts.
qwen-14b: small degradation on coding pass@1 (~-1.1%), otherwise stable.
pranav: awq results: lower latency vs gptq on same HW, but quality on qwen slightly worse (tradeoff). fp8/int8 quick tests looked promising for latency but need more eval sets.
lee: did you catch any kv-cache or stateful issues? reordering bugs?
pranav: yes — kv-cache mismatch reproduced only on mistral when seq_len > 8192. quick repro: ```python reproduce.py --model mistral-7b --seq 9000 --mode gptq``` it flips token alignment after generation step ~+6000.
maria: can we hold canary for mistral until that's fixed? prefer not to push to dedicated pool yet.
pranav: agree. propose actions:
 1) eng-runtime: add unit/regression test for kv cache at >8k (assign lee)
 2) eng-ml: rerun gptq for mistral with group=128 and group=256, and run awq baseline with same eval set (assign sara)
 3) ops: queue canary only if rerun shows no regressions (ops/sre to gate)
lee: on it — i'll add tests and kick off a minimal repro job in the next hour. will post logs.
sara: starting reruns now, will upload metric table + per-task diffs by EOD. planning to include longer-context prompt bank.
infra-bot: Job 4721 queued on prod-sim (A100-80GB) — ETA ~45m.
pranav: thanks all. i've marked mistral as "hold" on the bakeoff sheet and added a note linking to the repro. pls @mention me with results. :thumbsup:
